title: Create Without Nether
description: Datapack that adds recipes, so you don't have to go to the Nether for "Create" stuff.
body:
## This datapack allows player to fully enjoy "Create" mod, without needing to go to the Nether.
Recipes are not ot hard, but don't expect to craft everything in 2 recipes.
*I just want to warn you that there are some recipes that make some things, that you can use for something else than just crafting the "Nether stuff"*
**!RECOMMENDED TO USE "JEI" MOD!**

_(or any mod that works the same)_
# Here are the most (I think) important recipes:

**Netherrack**

![Netherrack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/130e1da889a5ca3f9413c43c87c0c540fe89a8e1.png)

**Soul Sand**

![Soul Sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/146e5d6406202ba67df2fd3a1de611d440985715.png)

**Blaze Burner**

![Blaze Burner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/606ee295fa08e7749f26b27334545858743c6d8a.png)

If you were wondering how to get "Shroomlight", just use bone meal on "Wapred/Crimson Fungus".

Funguses need the right ground to grow:

- "Warped Fungus" - "Warped Nylium"
- "Crimson Fungus" - "Crimson Nylium"
